# GameStar — Lösung für Räuber und Wegelagerer

- Original source: [GameStar — Lösung für Räuber und Wegelagerer](https://download.gamestar.de/public/31000/31061/01_2003_201ff.pdf)
- Author / publication: GameStar; individual author not verified
- Language / date: German; January 2003 issue, opening on printed page 201
- Access: Substantial indexed PDF text inspected; direct PDF retrieval failed
- Checked: 2026-09-09
- Format: original summary and research notes; not a transcript.

The opening of this numbered strategy guide focuses on squad composition, character roles, and camp training. It recommends combining archery, close combat, healing, and traversal abilities rather than selecting fighters alone.

Little John's carrying and climbing assistance and Will Scarlet's melee strength receive particular emphasis. The writer is less impressed by nets, beer, and hornets as practical tools. These are tactical judgments that can be compared with guides recommending greater use of distractions.

A caption also discusses forest targets, pits, and elevated positions against mounted enemies. The complete sequence of tips and later pages has not been inspected, so this record does not claim full walkthrough coverage.
